consequence.statement: The timestamp metrics do not record negative numbers for expired certificates; users relying on that should check the sign of rootCertExpirySeconds and certChainExpirySeconds instead. The text says this was never the actual behavior.

assertion.statement: The metrics rootCertExpiryTimestamp and certChainExpiryTimestamp no longer record a negative number for expired certs/chains (docs corrected to match actual behavior); users should check the signs of rootCertExpirySeconds and certChainExpirySeconds instead.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Metric consumption (dashboards/alerts relying on negative timestamp values) is not visible in static configuration.
